mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.body, c.status, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM creator_post_comment c INNER JOIN creator_post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.body, c.status, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM creator_post_comment c INNER JOIN creator_post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_post_comment c INNER JOIN creator_post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_post_comment c INNER JOIN creator_post p ON p.id = c.post_id SET c.status = 'DELETED', c.version = c.version + 1, c.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.version = #{expectedVersion} AND (c.user_id = #{actorId} OR p.owner_id = #{actorId})
